diagnosis.narrative: Trial 2 is a catastrophic regression from trial 1 (0.730 → 0.310 accuracy). The bundle of levers shifted: smaller chunks (512→256), weaker embedding (IEITYuan→MiniLM), vector-only BM25 dropped, top_k slashed (15→5), reranker removed, and reasoning disabled. The retrieval system collapsed: complete retrieval fell from 0.85 to 0.30, with retrieval_miss spiking to 0.39. The dominant failure mode is retrieval_miss on bridge questions (cross-document multi-hop), where 19 of 69 total failures occur. Compression to 256-token chunks with 32-token overlap likely fragmented critical spans, while MiniLM's weaker semantic signal failed to bridge lexical gaps. The top_k=5 constraint combined with no reranker means even when both spans exist in retrieved set, one often ranks below cutoff (retrieval_partial 0.31). Generation also degraded: acc_given_complete fell from 0.79 to 0.57, with reasoning disabled and Nova-micro showing systematic errors on inference/comparison questions. Notably, Q082 shows a refusal despite complete retrieval—the model sees the span but doesn't trust it, suggesting context quality or model calibration issues.
